7.3
Allowable Stresses
7.3.1
General
Stresses in masonry shall not exceed the values given in this Section. All
allowable stresses for working stress design may be increased one third when
considering wind or earthquake forces either acting alone or combined with
vertical loads. No increase shall be allowed for vertical loads acting alone.
